name: scottokeebs
description: A collection of free-to-build handwired keyboard and macropad projects.
readme_summary: This repository offers a comprehensive collection of free, open-source designs for building custom handwired mechanical keyboards and macropads. It provides detailed project files and guidance, enabling users to create their own unique input devices using common microcontrollers like Arduino Pro Micro or Raspberry Pi Pico.
key_features: Free-to-build handwired keyboard and macropad projects
Over 19 released projects
Projects designed for common 220x220mm 3D printers
Minimal support material required for 3D prints
Compatibility with Arduino Pro Micro and Raspberry Pi Pico
Open-source designs under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license
primary_use_case: Providing open-source designs and resources for hobbyists to build their own custom handwired mechanical keyboards and macropads.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a workshop, meticulously assembling a custom mechanical keyboard from individual components like switches, keycaps, and wires. The artisan is holding a blueprint that transforms into a glowing digital schematic as they work. Scattered around are 3D printed parts and a Raspberry Pi Pico microcontroller. Subtle UI elements showing keyboard layouts and code snippets are visible on a nearby screen. The scene is bathed in warm, focused light, emphasizing the craft and technology. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a focus on detail, clearly representing the creation of custom keyboards from open-source designs.

name: lipflow
description: Wispr Flow for your lips: hold a key, silently mouth words, and they're typed at your cursor. Runs locally on your Mac.
readme_summary: Lipflow is a local application for Mac, Windows, and Linux that transcribes silent lip movements captured by a webcam into text, which is then pasted at the cursor. It offers optional LLM-based cleanup for improved accuracy and customizes its language model based on user dictation history and practice.
key_features: Webcam-based lip reading for silent text transcription
Runs locally on Mac, Windows, and Linux
Optional LLM cleanup for enhanced accuracy
Personalized language model training using user dictation history
Customizable push-to-talk key and hands-free modes
GPU acceleration for lip reading and training on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs
primary_use_case: To provide a silent, hands-free method of text input by transcribing lip movements captured via a webcam, useful for situations where voice input is not feasible or desired.
cover_image_prompt: A close-up, stylized 3D isometric illustration of a person's mouth subtly moving, with glowing digital particles emanating from it. These particles are being captured by a sleek, modern webcam positioned nearby. The particles then flow into a stylized, abstract representation of a computer interface, transforming into clear, legible text that appears at a blinking cursor. Subtle UI elements showing lip landmarks and a small, glowing 'Lipflow' logo are visible. The overall mood is futuristic and efficient, with a clean, minimalist aesthetic and a cool blue and white color palette.

name: logo-design-skill
description: A comprehensive logo-design skill for Claude, Gemini CLI, Codex and other AI agents: principles, process, SVG craft, testing tools and a 1,400+ logo reference library.
readme_summary: This repository provides a comprehensive logo design skill for AI agents like Claude, Gemini CLI, and Codex. It guides users through the entire logo design process, from initial brief to production-ready SVG files and brand guidelines, incorporating design principles and a large reference library.
key_features: Covers logo design principles and process from brief to delivery.
Includes a searchable library of 1,400+ SVG logos classified by various attributes.
Provides dependency-free Python tools for auditing SVGs, creating test sheets, client presentation boards, and exporting icon sets.
Supports multiple AI agents through the open Agent Skills format.
Offers installation via plugin marketplace, manual copy, or direct download for different Claude versions and other agents.
primary_use_case: To empower AI agents to perform disciplined identity design and create professional logo assets.
cover_image_prompt: A master artisan, depicted as a stylized AI robot with a glowing blueprint interface, meticulously crafting a unique logo from raw geometric shapes and color swatches. The artisan is surrounded by floating icons representing different design stages: a magnifying glass for research, a lightbulb for concepts, a color wheel, and a final polished SVG file. Subtle digital particles flow from the blueprint to the finished logo, symbolizing the AI-driven design process. The background is a clean, modern studio with soft, focused lighting, emphasizing the creative and technical aspects of logo design. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a vibrant yet professional color palette.

name: openDAW
description: openDAW is a next-generation web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW)
readme_summary: openDAW is a next-generation, web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) focused on democratizing music production through accessible, high-quality creation tools. It prioritizes education and data privacy with a commitment to transparency, offering a completely free and open-source experience without sign-ups, tracking, or ads.
key_features: Web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW)
Democratizes music production
High-quality creation tools
Focus on education
Strong data-privacy (no sign-up, tracking, profiling, ads, etc.)
Open-source (AGPL v3)
Community-driven development
Potential for offline app and PWA
primary_use_case: To provide an accessible, free, and privacy-focused web-based platform for music production and education.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, open-air music studio set against a backdrop of a bustling, diverse city. In the center, a young person is effortlessly composing music on a sleek, futuristic laptop, with holographic sound waves and musical notes emanating from the screen. Surrounding them, people of all ages and backgrounds are gathered, some observing with curiosity, others actively participating with simple, intuitive interfaces projected around them. Subtle digital particles and glowing lines connect the elements, symbolizing the flow of creativity and data. The openDAW logo is subtly integrated into a nearby banner. The scene is bathed in warm, inviting light, conveying accessibility and community. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a bright, optimistic color palette.

name: Hunyuan3D-2-WinPortable
description: 📦Portable package for running Hunyuan3D 2.0/2.1 on Windows. | 混元 3D 2.0/2.1 整合包
readme_summary: This repository provides a portable package for running Hunyuan3D 2.0 and 2.1 on Windows. It integrates optimizations for consumer-grade GPUs and offers versions compatible with specific CUDA toolkits, simplifying the setup for 3D generation tasks.
key_features: Portable package for Hunyuan3D 2.0/2.1 on Windows
Optimized for consumer-grade GPUs (via mmgp integration)
Support for specific CUDA versions (12.6 and 12.9)
Clear instructions for setup and requirements
Optional Developer Mode for efficient model storage
primary_use_case: To provide an easy-to-install and run portable application for generating 3D models and textures using Hunyuan3D on Windows, optimized for users with consumer-grade NVIDIA GPUs.
cover_image_prompt: A digital sculptor in a clean, modern workshop, holding a glowing orb of raw 3D data. With a focused expression, they are using a holographic interface to shape the orb into a detailed 3D model, which is then projected onto a pedestal. Subtle streams of light representing code flow from the interface to the orb. The repository name 'Hunyuan3D Portable' is subtly etched onto a tool on the workbench. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, clean color palette and soft, ambient lighting, emphasizing the transformation of digital data into tangible 3D forms.
